title: Undercover
caption: Undercover (V)
game_text: Deploy on your spy at a site. Spy is now Undercover. During your control phase, may ▲ one Informant. At same and related sites, opponent’s {lightsaber} weapon destiny draws are -1 (-2 if targeting this character). {alter}
lore: The Empire maintains a network of spies attempting to infiltrate the Rebel Alliance or disinform their operatives.

notes: Dark-side Undercover (slip 50; Light is slip 24). The wiki VS3 stub ('Undercover (V) (Dark) (Virtual Set 3)') wrongly links the Light base page; base used is 'Undercover (Dark)'. Non-unique. Inline icon before 'weapon' is the black square with a diagonal green blade = {lightsaber} (the wiki stub writes [weapon]). Immunity icons on the slip are a letter in a red circle with a red slash (sheet ICON KEY: A = Immune to Alter, C = Immune to Control, S = Immune to Sense); tokened {alter}/{control}/{sense} as instructed (earlier files 03/08/10 used {icon:immune-*}). Printed face is the 350 px -decipher-archive gif; src/vs3/ANH-D-undercover.gif (also downloaded, 350 px) is the 'E' errata reprint face with different game text. Modern remake is Block-era only (VB1 -pre), modern=null.
